generate_python_sources_from_proto: run the generate_py_protobufs setuptools command to compile .proto files into Python source code
configure_extra_proto_paths: set additional import search paths for resolving .proto file dependencies in the generate_py_protobufs command
set_custom_protoc_path: configure a specific protoc binary path via the protoc option or PROTOC environment variable
initialize_command_options: call initialize_options to set default values for source_dir, output_dir, recurse, and protoc on the generate_py_protobufs command
finalize_and_validate_options: call finalize_options to validate source_dir, compute proto_root_path, discover .proto files, and locate the protoc binary
